head.title: Rootly CLI - Incident Not Found
head.summary: `rootly incidents get INC-31` returned "incident not found: INC-31" because the CLI sent the display ID to /v1/incidents/{id}, which accepts a UUID, slug or bare sequential number. PR #32 (v0.3.2, merged 2026-06-04) added NormalizeIncidentID and wired it into incidents get/update/delete, workflows run and status-page events; master already behaves as the ticket asks, so the likely outcome is no code change and a recommendation that the customer upgrade.

additions.text: Solve IR-5478 — one PR. `rootly incidents get INC-31` fails with "incident not found" though help says INC-123 format is accepted; resolve sequential IDs. Ref https://github.com/rootlyhq/rootly-cli/issues/28
additions.author: operator

criteria.text: `incidents get` with INC-31, inc-31 and bare 31 requests /v1/incidents/31, and a UUID is passed through unchanged (TestNormalizeIncidentID, TestRunGetNormalizesSequentialID, TestRunGetAcceptsUUID pass)
criteria.cites: `rootly incidents get INC-31` fails with "incident not found" though help says INC-123 format is accepted

criteria.text: Every command that takes an incident ID (incidents update, incidents delete, workflows run --incident, status-pages events list/create) calls api.NormalizeIncidentID before the API call, each covered by a test
Help text and README examples show INC-123 and match the behaviour; a real 404 reports "failed to get incident <id-as-typed>: incident not found"
criteria.cites: help says INC-123 format is accepted

changeKindReason: The ticket names the error "incident not found: INC-31", but the code on master already fixes it (PR #32), so this run only verifies the fix and makes no change unless the audit finds a gap.

redProof.reason: The bug is already fixed on master by PR #32 (v0.3.2), so no test can fail on the current code for the bug's reason; TestRunGetNormalizesSequentialID, which asserts INC-42 requests /v1/incidents/42, already passes at HEAD.
